prompts.purpose: Original material atlas for three period apparition candidate models
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: opaque albedo material atlas for real low-poly 3D models in Caelum Argenteum, nineteenth-century Argentine dark fantasy. Use the three supplied original character images only as identity/material references: image1 La Viuda, image2 La Llorona, image3 headless Futre. Produce ONE rectangular 4-column by 3-row atlas of TWELVE equal square cells, aspect ratio 4:3, no borders, no gaps, no labels, no text. Strict row-major contents: ROW1 CELL1 a straight-on orthographic face texture of the pale adult widow from image1, dark brown eyes with gray sockets, closed lips, face fills cell, front neutral expression, no hair over eyes; CELL2 straight-on orthographic face texture of the pale adult crying woman from image2, dark eyes, sorrowful brows, subtle tear streaks, face fills cell, no hair over eyes; CELL3 softly mottled pale cool-gray human skin surface only; CELL4 fine long black-brown hair strands surface only flowing vertically. ROW2 CELL1 very dark charcoal-black nineteenth-century mourning floral lace over opaque black cloth, readable fine embroidery; CELL2 weathered ivory dress damask from image2, fine floral fabric, subdued seams absent; CELL3 dark charcoal-brown brocade with restrained faded gold floral embroidery as Futre's coat and waistcoat, evenly distributed small motifs; CELL4 worn dark brown trouser wool, fine weave. ROW3 CELL1 faded deep burgundy silk sash fabric with subtle antique floral pattern; CELL2 distressed ivory lace over opaque ivory backing, small detailed lace pattern; CELL3 worn near-black boot/glove leather with subtle grain, no hardware; CELL4 subdued aged brass, fine tarnish, no objects. Face cells are albedo projections for sculpted heads, not promotional portraits: crop to forehead-cheeks-chin, frontal symmetrical head orientation, no shoulders, no framing hair. Texture cells must contain only flat-on continuous material surfaces filling every pixel, suitable for wrapping authored geometry; no whole garments, folds casting large shadows, objects, borders or grid lines. Painted realistic dark-fantasy finish matching original references, fine tactile detail, even diffuse light, no specular highlights, no gradients suggesting 3D balls. All cells strictly equally sized and completely opaque. Do not include a Futre face: he is headless.

Edit only the two face cells at top-left of this existing 4-column by 3-row opaque texture atlas. Preserve the exact atlas layout, cell boundaries, all ten other material cells, color style and identities. Both face crops currently cut off the chin. Each of those two face cells must show the COMPLETE FRONT FACE from a small margin above the forehead down to BELOW THE CHIN, with the chin fully visible and narrow plain pale-skin margins below it. Show full cheek boundaries too. Straight-on orthographic projection, neutral illumination, no shoulders, no perspective. Keep widow face in first cell and tear-streaked sorrowful face in second. Reduce face scale inside just those two cells enough to include forehead, eyebrows, both eyes, full nose, lips and entire chin. Do not add new material cells, grid lines, labels, objects, neck jewelry or shoulders. Keep the 4:3 aspect ratio and twelve equal square cells; all pixels opaque.
prompts.reason: Initial face crops omit the chin; complete facial projection is required.

review: Final atlas has complete frontal faces including chins and twelve equal opaque cells. Initial cropped-face variant retained. No post-generation pixel edits. Other material cells were regenerated by the edit; no byte-identity claim against the initial atlas.
